title: Petition of The Berkshire Gas Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell a promissory note or notes on a negotiated basis in the aggregated amount of up to $6,000,000 to be sold at par; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15; and pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 8 and 14, for approval and authorization to increase the Company's Common Stock, $2.50 par value and to issue and sell not in excess of 300,000 shares of Common Stock, $2.50 par value; and for such other action as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
